mapper.select: SELECT code AS code, code_name AS name FROM com_code WHERE parent_code = #{parentCode} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_order, code
SELECT dept_cd AS code, dept_nm AS name FROM hrm_org_dept WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY dept_level, dept_nm

SELECT hp.person_key AS person_key, hp.employee_no AS employee_no, hp.name_ko AS name_ko, hp.name_en AS name_en, hp.name_hanja AS name_hanja, hp.profile_photo_url AS profile_photo_url, hp.photo_url AS photo_url, hp.dept_cd AS dept_cd, d.dept_nm AS dept_name, hp.grade_code AS grade_code, grade.code_name AS grade_name, hp.position_code AS position_code, position.code_name AS position_name, hp.employment_type_code AS employment_type_code, employment.code_name AS employment_type_name, hp.service_status_code AS service_status_code, status.code_name AS service_status_name, hp.birth_date AS birth_date, hp.gender_code AS gender_code, hp.hire_date AS hire_date, hp.retire_date AS retire_date, hp.promotion_date AS promotion_date, hp.postal_code AS postal_code, hp.address_line1 AS address_line1, hp.address_line2 AS address_line2, hp.ai_profile ->> 'summary' AS ai_summary FROM hrm_person hp LEFT JOIN hrm_org_dept d ON hp.dept_cd = d.dept_cd AND d.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code grade ON hp.grade_code = grade.code AND grade.parent_code = '102' AND grade.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code position ON hp.position_code = position.code AND position.parent_code = '103' AND position.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code employment ON hp.employment_type_code = employment.code AND employment.parent_code = '104' AND employment.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code status ON hp.service_status_code = status.code AND status.parent_code = '101' AND status.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE hp.employee_no = #{employeeNo}

SELECT c.career_key AS career_key, c.company_name AS company_name, c.job_title AS job_title, c.job_responsibility AS job_responsibility, c.hire_date AS hire_date, c.retire_date AS retire_date, employment.code_name AS employment_type_name, c.remark AS remark FROM hrm_career c LEFT JOIN com_code employment ON c.employment_type_code = employment.code AND employment.parent_code = '104' AND employment.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE c.person_key = #{personKey} AND c.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY c.hire_date DESC, c.career_key

SELECT a.assignment_key AS assignment_key, a.assignment_date AS assignment_date, a.assignment_end_date AS assignment_end_date, assignment_type.code_name AS assignment_type_name, d.dept_nm AS dept_name, grade.code_name AS grade_name, position.code_name AS position_name, job_title.code_name AS job_title_name, a.assignment_content AS assignment_content, a.concurrent_assignment_yn AS concurrent_assignment_yn, a.remark AS remark FROM hrm_assignment a LEFT JOIN com_code assignment_type ON a.assignment_type_code = assignment_type.code AND assignment_type.parent_code = '105' AND assignment_type.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN hrm_org_dept d ON a.dept_cd = d.dept_cd AND d.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code grade ON a.grade_code = grade.code AND grade.parent_code = '102' AND grade.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code position ON a.position_code = position.code AND position.parent_code = '103' AND position.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN com_code job_title ON a.job_title_code = job_title.code AND job_title.parent_code = '106' AND job_title.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE a.person_key = #{personKey} AND a.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY a.assignment_date DESC, a.assignment_key
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hrm_person WHERE employee_no = #{employeeNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hrm_person ( employee_no, name_ko, name_en, name_hanja, dept_cd, grade_code, position_code, employment_type_code, service_status_code, birth_date, gender_code, hire_date, postal_code, address_line1, address_line2, reg_user ) VALUES ( #{person.employeeNo}, #{person.nameKo}, #{person.nameEn}, #{person.nameHanja}, #{person.deptCd}, #{person.gradeCode}, #{person.positionCode}, #{person.employmentTypeCode}, #{person.serviceStatusCode}, #{person.birthDate}::date, #{person.genderCode}, #{person.hireDate}::date, #{person.postalCode}, #{person.addressLine1}, #{person.addressLine2}, #{regUser} )
